_comment: Curated author-declared `provides` (capabilities) per plugin. This is a transparent, reviewable recommendation layer — semantic capability is not mechanically derivable, so it is curated by the standard's author. Chains absent from this map default to provides:[] (no capability advertised). If a chain already declares `provides` in its frontmatter, that value wins over this map. See docs/trigger-chain-plugin-standard.md §3.1 / §8.
